name: OlympiadBench
description: A challenging bilingual (English/Chinese) multimodal benchmark of 8,476 Olympiad-level competition problems in mathematics and physics, sourced from international and national Olympiad competitions. Each problem includes expert-authored step-by-step solution annotations. Problems cover proof-based mathematics, advanced physics reasoning, and cross-modal visual problem-solving. GPT-4V achieves only 17.97% overall (10.74% in physics).
evaluation_method: accuracy (exact answer matching with expert verification for open-ended)
typical_sota_score: ~17–40% overall (GPT-4V: 17.97%; frontier reasoning models as of 2025: ~35–45%)
reputation: Published at ACL 2024; 369+ citations; referenced in DeepSeek, Qwen, and multiple frontier model technical reports; one of the most challenging multilingual multimodal math benchmarks available
notes: ACL 2024. 369+ citations, widely referenced in major model technical reports. Problems from International Mathematical Olympiad (IMO), Chinese High School Math League (CHSML), Physics Olympiad competitions. Bilingual design tests both English and Chinese reasoning. Step-by-step expert annotations enable partial credit evaluation. GPT-4V achieves only 10.74% in physics — substantially below human olympiad participant performance.
